title: The Stolen Admin Login, A Weekend on Tina's Daybed in Luray, & Graduating for Good
description: When Chris steals an administrative login, scrambles Barnett Dorm's room assignments, and changes the admin password—and Center red tape forces staff to blindly follow the printout—Nate rescues Katie from Chris, neither twin sleeps a wink after learning what Chris did to Natalie, everyone is disgusted when classes continue like nothing happened, and a weekend sharing Tina's daybed in Luray gives Katie and Nate the strength to finish their PHP certificates and go home.
